024607: 
024608: // C11 6.7.9p9: unnamed members of a structure object take no part in
024609: // initialization, so a positional item skips an anonymous bit-field and lands
024610: // on the next member that has a name. The constant path spells the same rule
024611: // in c_ir_constant_initializer_field_at, and the two must agree or a local and
024612: // a static built from the same brace list read back differently. A named
024613: // member's own index is returned unchanged, so designators -- which resolve
024614: // their field by name before this runs -- are unaffected.
024615: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL u32 c_ir_compound_literal_positional_field(IrType* type, u32 field_index)
024616: {
024617:     u32 result = field_index;
024618:     if (type && (type->kind == IR_TYPE_STRUCT || type->kind == IR_TYPE_UNION))
024619:     {
024620:         while (result < type->field_count && type->fields[result].is_bit_field && !type->fields[result].name.length)
024621:         {
024622:             result += 1;
024623:         }
024624:     }
024625:     return result;
024626: }
